summary: Verified and fixed the detailed recipe ID integration with AI Chef. Original fix partially worked but had a bug: cached recipes weren't updated with new IDs. Applied additional fix to update cached recipes with recipe_id when provided. Complete E2E test verified: Chat -> Generate Recipe -> View Recipe -> AI Chef now works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix applied: When cached detailed_recipe is found but recipe_id differs, update the record with new ID to enable AI Chef lookup

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Complete E2E flow: Login -> Chat -> Mood -> Meal -> Dietary -> Cuisine -> Show Recipes -> View Recipe -> AI Chef)

seed_data_creation: None - tested with dynamically generated recipes
context_for_next_testing_agent: The detailed recipe ID fix is now complete. When /api/recipes/detailed is called with recipe_id, the backend saves the ID to detailed_recipes collection, allowing AI Chef endpoint to find the recipe. The fix handles both new recipe generation and cached recipe updates. E2E flow verified working.

rca_of_the_issue.problem: AI Chef showed 'Recipe Not Found' for newly generated chat recipes
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Two issues: 1) Original fix by main agent was correct for new recipes but 2) Cached recipes weren't being updated with the new recipe_id when provided, so previously cached recipes without ID couldn't be found by AI Chef
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added logic in /api/recipes/detailed endpoint (lines 115-120) to update cached recipes with the recipe_id if provided and different from existing ID
files_modified: /app/backend/routes/recipes.py - Added cache update logic for recipe_id
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Manual curl tests and Playwright E2E tests confirm fix works end-to-end
